title: Moving between places
hook: A small animal can change its surroundings.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The arrow moves the modeled lizard from the sunny rock to the shaded rock, stipulated here to be cooler. Some ectothermic reptiles use behavior to influence body temperature; real temperatures depend on time, weather and the animal.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: In a simple scene the sunny rock is warmer than the shaded rock. Which move exposes a lizard on the sunny rock to the cooler place?
